compatibility.notes: UNOFFICIAL BUILD. ThreadSaver has no public repository or developer feed - the IPA Vault source is the only distribution channel, so no developer-published download link exists to verify. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta. Uses the stock Threads bundle identifier, so installing it REPLACES the App Store Threads on device.
